title: Staging for Markus-static sites: gated preview prefix route and `content upload-preview`
description:
## Goal
Staging for Markus-static sites: the `staging` branch of the CMS app serves a prebuilt static preview of the DRAFT site (Markus build of `export-published --drafts`) from a private S3 prefix, behind the same Cognito/`editor`/`admin` gate as Pretext staging, enforced by AWS (the viewer's own Cognito-identity S3 permissions), with no stored token and no public bucket. Chosen design (docs/standard-site.md 1.10): not an Amplify WEB app; a Next catch-all behind the middleware gate streams objects from `preview/`.

## Context (verified)
- Storage rules: `amplify/storage/resource.ts`: `media/*` guest read, `editor`/`admin` read/write/delete; `corpora/*`, `newsroom/*` editor/admin. Groups map to identity-pool roles, so a signed-in editor's browser/server credentials can read prefixes granted to the group.
- `PPY-3e5e9d` provides `lib/site-env.ts`, `lib/staging-gate.ts` and the middleware gate; `PPY-1d0f3d` provides `papyrus content export-published --drafts` and `media_store.S3MediaStore`; the reader build (`build_markus_site`, `papyrus renderers markus-build`) is invoked by the publication's own `reader/` script.
- Server-side Amplify Storage: `aws-amplify/storage/server` `getUrl` inside `runWithAmplifyServerContext({ nextServerContext: { cookies } })` (the same server runner as `lib/amplify-server-runtime.ts`) presigns with the VIEWER's credentials.
- The staging build runs in Amplify with the service role (AdministratorAccess today, `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/amplify-app-shell.ts` L34-39; `PPY-39f928` narrows it) and mints a short-lived JWT for GraphQL (`papyrus auth refresh-jwt` reads the SSM secret).

## Exact changes
1. `amplify/storage/resource.ts`: add `"preview/*": [allow.groups(["editor", "admin"]).to(["read"])]` (writes come from the build role only).
2. `app/__preview/[...path]/route.ts` + `lib/staging-preview-object.ts` (new). `GET`: 404 unless `getSiteEnv() === "staging"` and `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW === "static"`; map the request path to candidate keys `preview/<path>`, `preview/<path>.html`, `preview/<path>/index.html` (empty/trailing-slash -> `index.html`); for each candidate call `getUrl({ path: key, options: { validateObjectExistence: true, expiresIn: 60 } })` through the server runner with the request cookies; first hit wins; none -> 404; `fetch` the presigned URL and stream the body with `Content-Type` from the S3 response, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. Reject path segments `..` and any `//`.
3. `middleware.ts`: when `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW=static` and staging: after the `PPY-3e5e9d` gate, rewrite every path that is not `/newsroom*`, `/api*`, `/_next*`, `/__preview*`, favicon/icon to `/__preview<path>` (so `/articles/foo.html` -> object `preview/articles/foo.html`). Production never rewrites.
4. `src/papyrus_content/preview_upload.py` + CLI `papyrus content upload-preview --dir DIR [--bucket B] [--prefix preview/] [--json]` (wire in `cli.py`): sync a built site directory to the `preview/` prefix with boto3: upload new/changed files (sha256 stored in object metadata, content type from `mimetypes`, `CacheControl: no-store`), delete keys under the prefix that are no longer in DIR, refuse a prefix other than `preview/`, refuse an empty DIR; prints counts.
5. Staging build contract (documented in `docs/site-hosting.md`, implemented in the generated build spec by `PPY-39f928`): `papyrus auth refresh-jwt --write-env .env` -> `papyrus content export-published --drafts --out content-export --clean` -> `python reader/build.py --content content-export --out dist` -> `papyrus content upload-preview --dir dist` -> then the CMS Next build (frontend-only, no `backend:` phase).
6. `docs/standard-site.md` stays as is (design); add the runbook text to `docs/site-hosting.md` ("Static staging").

## Data shapes
Object keys: `preview/index.html`, `preview/articles/foo.html`, `preview/assets/hello/a.png`, `preview/css/site-theme.css`. Env on the staging branch: `SITE_ENV=staging`, `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW=static`, `PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=published` (unused in static mode).

## Tests
- TS unit `scripts/test-staging-preview-keys.ts` (tsx): candidate-key mapping for `/`, `/articles/foo.html`, `/articles/foo`, `/articles/`, `/a/../b` (rejected), `//x` (rejected).
- Python unit `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_preview_upload.py` with a fake S3 (`DirMediaStore`-like in-memory client or `unittest.mock`): uploads changed files only, deletes stale keys under `preview/`, refuses a different prefix, refuses empty dir, sets content types.
- Gherkin: `features_backend/preview-upload.feature` ("Uploading a built site replaces the preview prefix", "An empty build is refused"); cucumber `features/staging-guards.feature` (from `PPY-3e5e9d`) gets a `@staging-static` scenario: with `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW=static` and a stub storage, `/articles/foo.html` is rewritten to the preview route (unit-level through the middleware function; no S3 needed).
- Sandbox (AWS; `AGENTS.local.md`): deploy the storage rule to a sandbox, `papyrus content upload-preview --dir <small dist>`, then with the `scripts/staging-auth-test.mjs` pattern (from `PPY-3e5e9d`): editor gets 200 and the HTML for `/articles/foo.html`; anonymous is redirected; non-editor user gets 403; direct unsigned S3 URL of the object returns 403.

## Acceptance checks
- `npx tsx scripts/test-staging-preview-keys.ts`, `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.test_preview_upload -v`, `poetry run behave features_backend/preview-upload.feature`, `npx tsc --noEmit` pass.
- Sandbox checks above pass; `aws s3api get-bucket-policy-status` shows the media bucket is not public (unchanged).
- `SITE_ENV=production npm run dev`: `/__preview/index.html` returns 404.

## Dependencies
Blocked by `PPY-3e5e9d` (site-env, gate, middleware), `PPY-1d0f3d` (drafts export, media store). Blocks the Phase 3 static-staging proof (Pilobol.us/Anth.us). `PPY-39f928` generates the build spec and grants the build role write on `preview/*`.

## Risks
- Large sites (hundreds of MB): each request presigns once (cheap) but streams through compute; Amplify compute response size limits (6 MB) apply to streamed responses on Lambda-backed compute; if hit, return a `307` to the presigned URL for objects > 4 MB (images) instead of proxying. Decide with a measured test on the Anth.us staging output.
- Branch-level env vars on Amplify are per branch; make sure production never inherits `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW`.
- Relative links inside the exported pages work because the preview is served from the staging origin root.

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-f00c89-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
